# delpassword

Deletes a password.

```ttl
delpassword <filename> <password name>
```

## Parameters

**string &lt;filename&gt;**

Password file name.

**string &lt;password name&gt;**

Password identifier.

## Remarks

Deletes a password specified by &lt;password name&gt; in the password file &lt;filename&gt;.
If &lt;password name&gt; is a blank string, all passwords in the file are deleted.

## Example

```ttl
delpassword 'password.dat' 'foo'
```
